meta.paragraph: Imports of Ictalurus spp., Pangasius spp., and other catfish of the order Siluriformes for August 2026 totaled 18.5 million pounds, a 32 percent decrease from August 2025 and came from China, Thailand, and Vietnam. Exports of fresh and frozen catfish products totaled 52 thousand pounds, with fresh product going to Bahamas, Canada, Turks and Caicos Islands, and United Arab Emirates, and frozen product going to Cayman Islands, Guatemala, and Spain. The U.S. Department of Commerce compiles import/export data.

forms: Whole or dressed, fresh or chilled
